'''Palkandi Brokerage House''' was an investment company that allowed the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]] to invest in [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] stock exchanges. Palkandi was funded by proceeds from illegal gambling operations.
